concept.th-version-control.def: A tool that tracks every change to your code, so you never lose work and can see what changed and when.
concept.th-commit.def: A saved snapshot of your code at a moment worth keeping, with a short message describing the change.
concept.th-history.def: The timeline of all commits - how the code grew, snapshot by snapshot.
concept.th-collaboration.def: Several people working on one project, each committing their own changes without overwriting each other.
concept.th-vcs-branch.def: A separate line of commits that splits off from the main one, so you can try a change without touching the version that works.
concept.th-merge.def: Bringing a branch's commits back into the main line, so two histories become one again.
concept.th-remote.def: A shared copy of the history that lives on a server, so a whole team pushes and pulls commits through one agreed place - often hosted on a platform like GitHub.
